flags.title: Losses bigger than the stop
flags.text: 1 losses were 1.5R or worse (worst -1.5R) - the stop was moved, gapped or not placed.
flags.tip: Never widen a stop. Keep the broker-side stop order (the platform places it in LIVE) and size smaller before results or events.

flags.title: Too few trades to judge
flags.text: Only 2 closed trades; any edge (or flaw) is not reliable before about 20-30.
flags.tip: Keep paper trading the same rules; do not change three things at once.
